description: This file defines API routes for managing restaurants, menu items, and orders owned by a restaurant owner. It includes CRUD operations for restaurants and menu items, as well as listing and updating orders and their statuses, with appropriate authentication and authorization checks.

classes.name: Restaurant
classes.description: ORM model representing a restaurant owned by a user.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: ORM model representing a menu item in a restaurant.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: ORM model representing a customer order for a restaurant.

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: ORM model tracking status changes for an order.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enum defining different user roles, including OWNER.

classes.name: APIMessage
classes.description: Schema for generic API message responses.

classes.name: MenuItemCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new menu item.

classes.name: MenuItemResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning menu item data.

classes.name: MenuItemUpdateRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a menu item.

classes.name: OwnerUpdateOrderStatusRequest
classes.description: Schema for owner updating order status.

classes.name: RestaurantCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new restaurant.

methods.name: Restaurant _ensure_owner_restaurant(db: Session, owner_id: int, restaurant_id: int)
methods.description: Checks that a restaurant exists and belongs to the owner, raises HTTP 404 if not.

methods.name: List[RestaurantResponse] list_my_restaurants( db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Retrieves all restaurants owned by the authenticated owner.

methods.name: RestaurantResponse create_restaurant( payload: RestaurantCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Creates a new restaurant for the owner.

methods.name: RestaurantResponse update_restaurant( restaurant_id: int, payload: RestaurantUpdateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Updates details of a restaurant owned by the owner.

methods.name: APIMessage delete_restaurant( restaurant_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Deletes a restaurant owned by the owner, cascading to menu items.

methods.name: MenuItemResponse create_menu_item( restaurant_id: int, payload: MenuItemCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Creates a new menu item in a specified restaurant.

methods.name: MenuItemResponse update_menu_item( menu_item_id: int, payload: MenuItemUpdateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Updates a menu item, verifying ownership of the restaurant.

methods.name: APIMessage delete_menu_item( menu_item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Deletes a menu item, verifying ownership.

methods.name: List[OrderResponse] list_orders( db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Lists all orders for restaurants owned by the owner.

methods.name: OrderResponse get_order( order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific order, verifying ownership.

methods.name: OrderResponse update_order_status( order_id: int, payload: OwnerUpdateOrderStatusRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
methods.description: Updates the status of an order and logs the change.

ctags.name: _ensure_owner_restaurant
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure_owner_restaurant(db: Session, owner_id: int, restaurant_id: int) -> Restaurant:$/

ctags.signature: ( restaurant_id: int, payload: MenuItemCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )

ctags.name: update_menu_item
ctags.signature: ( menu_item_id: int, payload: MenuItemUpdateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )

ctags.name: update_order_status
ctags.signature: ( order_id: int, payload: OwnerUpdateOrderStatusRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )

ctags.name: update_restaurant
ctags.signature: ( restaurant_id: int, payload: RestaurantUpdateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner=Depends(require_role(UserRole.OWNER)), )
